title: Apply for the Pre-IVF Fertility Testing Rebate
summary: Find out how to apply for a one-time $250 rebate to help cover the costs of eligible pre-IVF fertility testing.
intro:
The Pre-IVF Fertility Testing Rebate helps eligible NSW residents cover the costs of fertility testing.

If you have incurred out-of-pocket costs for eligible fertility tests after 30 September 2019, you can apply for a one-time $250 rebate, regardless of when you took the tests.

You can only apply for the rebate once.

### Before you apply

Ask your fertility specialist to:

The following specialists can confirm your eligibility for the rebate:
who_can_apply: Be a woman (only women can submit the application, even if the test was for a man or male donor).
Have been referred for eligible fertility tests by a general practitioner or a specialist.
Have a receipt showing out-of-pocket costs for eligible pre-IVF fertility testing after 30 September 2019.
what_you_need: The name of your fertility specialist.
The Pre-IVF Fertility Testing Rebate Declaration form (completed by your specialist, not your GP). If claiming for a man’s or male donor’s test, the specialist must also sign the form.
One receipt showing out-of-pocket costs for eligible fertility testing (this can be for less than the rebate amount).
Your bank account details for the electronic funds transfer.

how_to_steps.text: Log in or create your MyServiceNSW Account.
Follow the prompts to apply for the rebate.

more_info.text: After your application has been successfully reviewed and approved you receive the rebate in your nominated bank account within 28 days.
The rebate can only be claimed for out-of-pocket costs after claims from Medicare have been made.
The Pre-IVF Fertility Testing Rebate is available until 30 June 2026.

Service NSW stores the health data you provide, including which specialist you’re seeing and that you’ve had a fertility test. To validate your application, Service NSW employees will review your uploaded ‘Pre-IVF Fertility Testing Rebate’ and receipt.

faqs.a: You can apply for a one-time $250 rebate.

faqs.q: Who can apply for the rebate?
faqs.a: You must be a NSW resident, a woman, and have been referred for eligible fertility tests by a general practitioner or a specialist.

faqs.q: What costs are covered by the rebate?
faqs.a: The rebate covers out-of-pocket costs for eligible fertility tests incurred after 30 September 2019.
